title: Spinach and Sweet Potato Side
preamble:
2 orange-fleshed sweet potatoes , cut into chunks

200g spinach , washed & roughly chopped

4 naan bread , warmed through

400g tin coconut milk

1 onion , finely sliced
ingredients: 2 orange-fleshed sweet potatoes , cut into chunks
2-3 madras curry paste , depending on how hot you like your curry
method: Fry the onions until very soft, about 8 minutes. Stir in the paste and fry for 2 minutes. Add the coconut milk and sweet potatoes and cook until just tender, about 10 minutes. Stir through the spinach until wilted. Serve with naan breads.
details: Category: Vegey or Lentil Based Curry and Dahls
